name: Burbank Town Center
summary: Burbank Town Center is a contemporary three-story regional mall featuring over 100 retail shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues including an AMC theater. Located in Downtown Burbank near major studios like Disney and Warner Bros., the center serves as a landmark shopping destination just 25 minutes from Los Angeles.
demographics: Burbank Town Center attracts a diverse demographic mix reflective of the greater Burbank area, which includes entertainment industry professionals, young families, and middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area serves residents from Burbank, Glendale, and surrounding San Fernando Valley communities, with median household incomes ranging from $65,000 to $95,000. Primary visitors include millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-54 who work in nearby media studios and seek convenient shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The center benefits from both local residential traffic and destination visitors drawn to the area's proximity to major studios like Disney and Warner Bros.
description: Burbank Town Center stands as a landmark shopping destination in Downtown Burbank, just 25 minutes from Los Angeles and conveniently located off Interstate 5. Known as the "Media Capital of the World," Burbank is home to iconic entertainment studios including Walt Disney and Warner Bros., and this three-story contemporary shopping center reflects the vibrant, creative energy of its surroundings. The center features more than 100 retail shops, restaurants, entertainment venues, and lifestyle services, offering visitors a comprehensive shopping and entertainment experience. Major attractions include an AMC multiplex theater for catching the latest films and popular retailers like H&M, providing both fashion-forward shopping and family entertainment under one roof. With its prime location just miles northeast of Hollywood and its diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment amenities, Burbank Town Center serves as a central gathering place for both local residents and visitors exploring the greater Los Angeles area.
